summary.ml_models_verified: XGBoost Susceptibility & Trigger in data/ml/ (verified operational)
summary.real_data_providers: Open-Meteo (Rainfall, Soil Moisture, Weather), Copernicus DEM (Terrain), ESA Sentinel-2 (Satellite), GSI NLSM (Historical Landslides), NewsAPI (News)

requirements_audit.name: Rainfall patterns
requirements_audit.data_source: Open-Meteo live meteorological API
requirements_audit.pipeline: Open-Meteo API -> rainfallIngestionService -> MongoDB RainfallObservation -> AreaIntelligence / RiskAssessment -> AreaIntelligencePanel
requirements_audit.caching: In-memory TTL (15 min), deduplication of in-flight promises
requirements_audit.failure_handling: 504 timeout detection, 429 backoff, no zero-substitution fabrication

requirements_audit.name: Soil moisture sensors
requirements_audit.data_source: Open-Meteo live volumetric soil water index (0-7cm, 7-28cm)
requirements_audit.pipeline: Open-Meteo API -> soilMoistureIngestionService -> MongoDB SoilMoistureObservation -> Evidence Fusion -> Dashboard & Map UI
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Safe null fallback, failure does not crash risk pipeline

requirements_audit.name: Satellite imagery
requirements_audit.data_source: Esri World Imagery + ESA Sentinel-2 / WorldCover land cover classifications
requirements_audit.pipeline: ArcGIS Tiles & ESA Sentinel-2 -> satelliteLandCoverService -> RiskMap (Basemap & Overlays) -> User
requirements_audit.caching: Tile browser caching, in-memory land cover classification cache
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Defaults to neutral contribution (0 pts), never fabricates stabilizing vegetation

requirements_audit.name: Terrain/slope
requirements_audit.data_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 local tiles (90m resolution) + Open-Meteo Elevation fallback
requirements_audit.pipeline: Copernicus DEM / Open-Meteo -> terrainService -> TerrainCache -> RiskAssessment & ML Susceptibility -> Map & Dashboard
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Timeout / rate-limit detection, skips susceptibility safely without sea-level substitution

requirements_audit.name: Historical landslides
requirements_audit.data_source: Geological Survey of India (GSI) National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) official dataset (10,236 records)
requirements_audit.pipeline: GSI Clean Dataset -> MongoDB LandslideEvent -> landslideEventService -> preclassifyHistoricalEvents (10km density) -> RiskMap Historical Mode
requirements_audit.evidence: src/models/LandslideEvent.test.js pass, 10,412 documents in live MongoDB
requirements_audit.caching: 2dsphere spatial index in MongoDB, preclassified memoization in frontend
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Strict isolation: historical records NEVER trigger early warnings and NEVER fabricate current hazards

requirements_audit.name: AI/ML high-risk prediction
requirements_audit.data_source: Real trained XGBoost models (data/ml/xgboost_susceptibility_model.json & xgboost_trigger_model.json)
requirements_audit.pipeline: Terrain & Rainfall features -> mlPredictionService -> Python Bridge (mlPredictBridge.py) -> XGBoost native inference -> /api/ml/predict & riskScoreService
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Strict input validation (rejection of NaN/Inf/missing features without zero conversion), bounded 5000ms execution, graceful unavailable status

requirements_audit.name: Real-time alerts
requirements_audit.data_source: Current meteorological telemetry, soil moisture, and active field reports
requirements_audit.pipeline: Telemetry -> earlyWarningService -> earlyWarningController -> /api/early-warning -> Alerts page & Notification Center
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Generates WATCH, WARNING, CRITICAL strictly from current evidence; historical data barred from triggering

requirements_audit.name: GIS vulnerable zones
requirements_audit.data_source: NER Bounding Polygon (21.5°N–29.5°N, 89.5°E–97.5°E) across all 8 Northeastern States
requirements_audit.pipeline: Coordinates -> GIS Grid Boundary Validation -> Spatial Clustering -> RiskMap Viewport
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Rejects coordinates outside NER boundary with clear error message

requirements_audit.name: Roads
requirements_audit.data_source: InfrastructureAsset model (NH, SH, arterial hill corridors)
requirements_audit.pipeline: MongoDB InfrastructureAsset -> infrastructurePriorityService -> AreaIntelligencePanel -> Road Status Badges
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Honest empty state when no assets mapped in immediate sector

requirements_audit.name: Villages
requirements_audit.data_source: GeocodingService & Settlement directory
requirements_audit.pipeline: User Search -> GeocodingService (Nominatim/Overpass with fallback) -> AreaSearch -> Map Navigation -> AreaIntelligence
requirements_audit.caching: In-memory search cache with debounce and cancellation
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Handles provider offline states gracefully, displays 'No locations found'

requirements_audit.name: Infrastructure
requirements_audit.data_source: InfrastructureAsset model (bridges, power, water, hospitals)
requirements_audit.pipeline: Infrastructure Asset CRUD -> Operational Priority Scoring -> Dashboard & Sector Intelligence
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Safe score clamping in [0, 100]

requirements_audit.name: Citizen reports
requirements_audit.data_source: Citizen submitted observations (coordinates, photo URL, hazard description, severity)
requirements_audit.pipeline: Citizen UI -> fieldReportService -> /api/field-reports -> MongoDB FieldReport -> Field Officer Verification Workflow
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Coordinate bounds checking, rate limiting, offline queue storage when disconnected

requirements_audit.name: Field officials
requirements_audit.data_source: Authorized Field Team and Authority logins (JWT role-based)
requirements_audit.pipeline: Field Team Dashboard -> /api/field-reports/:id/verify -> Status update -> Evidence Fusion integration
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Role enforcement (field_team / authority required), 403 Access Denied for citizen

requirements_audit.name: Risk severity dashboard
requirements_audit.data_source: Aggregated intelligence across telemetry, active alerts, news, and priority assets
requirements_audit.pipeline: dashboardIntelligenceController -> /api/dashboard/intelligence -> Dashboard.jsx
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Clean loading skeletons and honest empty states

requirements_audit.name: Road connectivity status
requirements_audit.data_source: Infrastructure asset condition reports and environmental hazard overlap
requirements_audit.pipeline: Hazard Context + Road Asset -> infrastructurePriorityService -> Connectivity Disruption Score -> UI Warning
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Defaults to normal connectivity if no hazard detected

requirements_audit.name: Weather-linked forecasts
requirements_audit.data_source: Open-Meteo Forecast endpoint
requirements_audit.pipeline: Forecast API -> OpenMeteoProvider -> rainfallIngestionService -> Dashboard & AreaIntelligence
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Structured error fallback without UI crash

requirements_audit.name: Emergency prioritisation
requirements_audit.data_source: Fusion score, infrastructure asset criticality, vulnerability index
requirements_audit.pipeline: Evidence Fusion -> calculateOperationalPriority -> Rank (P1 Urgent to P4 Low) -> Dashboard Priority Table
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Strict mathematical clamping to [0, 100]

requirements_audit.name: Multilingual notifications
requirements_audit.data_source: Tri-lingual localization dictionary (English, Hindi, Assamese)
requirements_audit.pipeline: LanguageContext -> locales/{en,hi,as} -> Dynamic Pattern Matcher -> NotificationCenter & Alert Cards
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Graceful fallback to English if key or phrase translation is missing

requirements_audit.name: Low-network/offline
requirements_audit.data_source: Browser CacheStorage & Service Worker (ner-lmrs-shell-v1) + LocalStorage
requirements_audit.pipeline: navigator.onLine -> NetworkContext -> Service Worker shell cache & Offline Queue Service -> UI Offline Banner
requirements_audit.caching: Stale-While-Revalidate for app shell; API requests strictly bypass cache to prevent stale hazard fabrication
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Offline banner displayed, live fetches paused, queued reports preserved

requirements_audit.name: IMD/weather integration
requirements_audit.data_source: Open-Meteo calibrated with IMD standard meteorological rainfall intensity thresholds
requirements_audit.pipeline: Rainfall Ingestion -> IMD Threshold Classifier -> earlyWarningService -> Alerts
requirements_audit.evidence: src/services/earlyWarningService.js (IMD thresholds: 64.5mm heavy, 115.5mm very heavy, 204.4mm extreme)
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Clean status logging on provider network error

requirements_audit.name: Satellite feeds
requirements_audit.data_source: ESA Sentinel-2 / WorldCover + Esri World Imagery WMS/Tile Server
requirements_audit.pipeline: Satellite Providers -> satelliteLandCoverService -> /api/satellite/land-cover -> RiskMap & Evidence Fusion
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Rate-limit detection, neutral fallback score (0 pts)

requirements_audit.name: Sensor data
requirements_audit.data_source: Virtual IoT telemetry streams (Rainfall & Soil Moisture monitoring)
requirements_audit.pipeline: Telemetry stream -> rainfallObservationRoutes & soilMoistureRoutes -> MongoDB -> Risk Assessment
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Rejects malformed sensor payloads with HTTP 400

requirements_audit.name: SMS/app warning
requirements_audit.data_source: In-app NotificationCenter + SMS Gateway Dispatcher Architecture
requirements_audit.pipeline: Alert Event -> notificationService -> MongoDB Notification -> In-app WebSocket/Poll -> Notification Center
requirements_audit.evidence: src/models/Notification.test.js, notificationService.test.js pass; external SMS telecom gateway requires carrier API credentials
requirements_audit.failure_handling: In-app alerts 100% operational; SMS dispatches fail safely to internal log when credentials unconfigured

requirements_audit.name: Cloud/deployment architecture
requirements_audit.data_source: Node.js Express + MongoDB Atlas + Vite SPA local servers
requirements_audit.pipeline: Development servers running on localhost:5000 and localhost:5173
requirements_audit.evidence: package.json scripts, verified live HTTP 200 responses
requirements_audit.failure_handling: CORS protection, environment variable configuration via .env

requirements_audit.name: Offline sync
requirements_audit.data_source: localStorage queued citizen reports
requirements_audit.pipeline: Offline Submit -> offlineQueueService -> Window online event -> Automatic replay with Idempotency Key -> Backend /api/field-reports
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Prevents duplicate creation through UUID idempotency keys

requirements_audit.name: Disaster-only news filtering
requirements_audit.data_source: NewsAPI live news provider
requirements_audit.pipeline: NewsAPI Provider -> disasterNewsFilter (regex filter + metaphor rejector) -> NewsItem Model -> News.jsx
requirements_audit.caching: 1-hour sync window in NewsSyncMeta with 5-minute failure backoff
requirements_audit.failure_handling: Rejects metaphorical news ('landslide victory', 'flood of complaints') without extra API calls

historical_mode.segregation: Himachal and non-NER NASA records strictly segregated and excluded from NER map canvas

thresholds.INSUFFICIENT: < 10 records within 10 km (Hidden visually to avoid canvas clutter; retained in underlying dataset)

historical_mode.alert_safety: Historical records NEVER trigger alerts or current risk scoring

current_mode.data_integrity: Renders strictly real active assessments and verified field incidents; zero synthetic markers
current_mode.empty_state: Honest UI notice displayed when zero active risk assessments exist in the sector
current_mode.loading_state: Clean spinner overlay with user feedback

basemaps.place_name_overlay: Esri World Boundaries and Places Reference tile layer rendered in overlayPane (zIndex: 300) so labels remain crisp above satellite imagery
basemaps.control_isolation: Map floating controls use stopPropagation and disableClickPropagation to prevent accidental coordinate selection
basemaps.state_preservation: Switching basemap preserves center, zoom, and selected location

ml_ai_audit.inference_engine: Native XGBoost via isolated Python bridge (mlPredictBridge.py)
ml_ai_audit.validation_rules: Strict numeric, finite, non-null; no zero substitution; bounded 5000ms timeout

production_integration.evidence_fusion: Evidence fusion gracefully reports 'Data Limitation' when model artifacts are missing in secondary wrappers without crashing
